scope: Lazy same-process FrameLocator paths and shared native trace attempt retention. Native macOS arm64/Bun1.4.2 development acceptance; no release or performance claim.
changes: Public frame descriptors keep the original root Frame; pinned parser composition supplies lazy iframe components and final selector.
Native operations resolve temporary iframe owners under bounded original-document allocation, then reuse existing child-world actions, captured-node evaluation and deadlines.
Each eligible retry resolves the entire ancestor path. Frame-path assertions use host retries to observe a selector switching between still-live frames.
Method-specific strictness and absence match the characterized reference; list reads keep first-match iframe behavior while actions/assertions stay strict.
Element resolution captures its before phase and uploads capture their original input target. Settled input phases may repeat across attempts without reopening pending or sealed ownership.
retainedDevelopmentAttempts: The first differential failed before browser launch on a duplicate upstream runner import; using the retained byte-identical expect module repaired the harness.
The second differential retained six fixture expectation/classification failures: duplicate-frame list reads return the first text, and matcher-wrapped strictness must be classified as strictness.
The third differential passed212 functional checks; archive review exposed two missing element-resolution before snapshots and two upload input phases.
The fourth differential and strengthened trace verifier passed after both native phase repairs.

A targeted native-input-lock/replacement reproduction then proved later input attempts were absent from archives. The shared recording fix preserves both attempts and the pinned viewer first-snapshot selection.
The first full core run was deliberately interrupted after69 started groups to include the retry repair. Its watchdog confirmed no remaining observed processes. The final151-group run completed.
limitations: Out-of-process frame routing remains explicitly unsupported.
Only the declared default/options/value combinations are experimentally verified; no exhaustive FrameLocator/getBy option claim.
Frame-path assertions use ordinary host retries, rather than the resident observation path used for known-frame assertions.

Trace checks cover call/phase/source custody, child target ancestry, backreferences and filmstrip resources. They do not establish universal visual fidelity; native viewer fixtures pass separately in core.
A trace input snapshot describes an attempt, not proof of input delivery. Pinned viewers select the first same-name snapshot; later attempts remain archived.
Downloads, broader migration/consumer coverage, native Linux, fresh matched performance and release acceptance remain open.
evidenceNormalization: Only workstation path strings and dependent hashes change; numeric/boolean/null observations remain exact. Raw trace archives stay private at recorded hashes and fixtures regenerate them.
